verdict.rationale: cubic.yaml provides per-repo config (source of truth for review behavior, ignore patterns, custom agents) and custom agents/RBAC roles suggest some centralized governance, but evidence shows configuration is per-repository (cubic.yaml lives in each repo root) rather than an org-level policy pushed/enforced across hundreds of repos with a central exceptions dashboard. missing for 10: an org-wide policy/template propagation mechanism across many repos, a central exceptions-management UI/workflow, and independent evidence of usage at hundreds-of-repos scale.
